items.name: Flax Cumin Dry Sprinkle
steps: Toast the flax just until it begins to crackle and move it aside.
Warm cumin and coriander, then cool all the seeds.
Pulse coarsely with salt and store the sprinkle cold and dry.
items.guidance: Flax Cumin Dry Sprinkle is a concentrated accompaniment; use a small portion with a compatible meal Vata: pair it with warm moist food and avoid an oversized raw portion. Pitta: reduce sourness and hot chili where present. Kapha: keep oil and sweetener restrained while favoring pungent aromatics.
